# `response-media-type-removed`

Response media type removed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `response-media-type-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Responses ([RULES.md section 6](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A response can no longer return a media type. Media types compare case-insensitively.

## Why this default

Clients asking for it in `Accept` get 406 or an unexpected format.

## Example

From test case [`response-media-type-removed`](../../test/cases/response-media-type-removed/): A response media type clients may request was removed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
                schema:
                  type: object
-             application/xml:
-               schema:
-                 type: object
```

Findings:

- `response-media-type-removed` · error · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  response-media-type-removed: error
```

## How to fix

Keep returning the media type until clients have moved.
